model_annotation: Figure 3 is a line chart that compares the performance of three different models, namely lattice, FLAT, and OURS, in terms of their speed. The x-axis represents the number of epochs, ranging from 0 to 18, while the y-axis represents the speed, ranging from 0.55 to 0.80. The lattice model shows a steady increase in speed, reaching a peak of 0.80 at 18 epochs. The FLAT model shows a more gradual increase, reaching a peak of 0.75 at 18 epochs. The OURS model shows a similar trend to the FLAT model, but with a slightly higher peak of 0.78 at 18 epochs.
